name: Feature request

title: "[feature] "

## Problem

What pain does this solve? Who else hits this?

## Proposed solution

What you want to be able to do after this lands.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you weighed. Why this one?

## Scope

- [ ] Tiny — one file, < 50 lines
- [ ] Small — local change, no API change
- [ ] Medium — touches public API or schema
- [ ] Large — needs design discussion first

## Willing to PR?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to implement this myself
- [ ] No, just proposing — happy to review
- [ ] Open to it if a maintainer guides
